steps.caption: requestAnimationFrame вика функцията преди всеки кадър.
steps.code:
<style>body{margin:0}</style>
<canvas width="400" height="160" style="background:#0f172a"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const ball = { x: 30 };

function frame() {
  ball.x += 3;                    // 3 пиксела на кадър
  if (ball.x > 370) ball.x = 30;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 400, 160);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f97316";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, 80, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

steps.caption: Скорост в пиксели за секунда, умножена по делтата на времето.
steps.code:
<style>body{margin:0}</style>
<canvas width="400" height="160" style="background:#0f172a"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const ball = { x: 30, vx: 180 };      // пиксела в секунда
let last = 0;

function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.1);
  last = now;
  ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
  if (ball.x > 370 || ball.x < 30) ball.vx = -ball.vx;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 400, 160);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f97316";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, 80, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame((t) => { last = t; frame(t); });
</script>

steps.caption: Броячът показва колко кадъра са минали за секунда.
steps.code:
<style>body{margin:0}</style>
<canvas width="400" height="160" style="background:#0f172a"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const ball = { x: 30, vx: 180 };      // пиксела в секунда
let last = 0, frames = 0;

function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.1);
  last = now;
  ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
  if (ball.x > 370 || ball.x < 30) ball.vx = -ball.vx;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 400, 160);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f97316";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, 80, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  frames++;
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame((t) => { last = t; frame(t); });
setTimeout(() => console.log("кадри за 1 секунда:", frames), 1000);
</script>
